objectives.note: The elves join only if their stolen moonstone comes home. Opinion choices: 我同意 / 我觉得...

objectives.note: The dwarves need shadow crystals to rebuild the Harmony Bell's frame.

quests.summary: Collect 5 shadow crystals from imps so Uncle Shi's dwarves can rebuild the Harmony Bell's frame.

objectives.note: The beastfolk champion wants proof you fight for everyone.
Dachui cheers from the sidelines (no combat change).

quests.summary: Defeat 6 demon knights in the Throne Hall levels to earn the beastfolk's trust.

objectives.note: Uncle Wind: three dragonlings are caged in the castle.

quests.summary: Free three caged dragonlings in the castle's first levels so the dragons join the alliance.

objectives.note: 'A hero is someone who gets up again.'
Her old badge, lost 50 years ago (quest item before the chest). Step scene sc_q9_second_wind_badge plays on arrival.
Answer 12 Gate (L9.1) words correctly in battles.
She teaches 再起 Second Wind (spec: Castle quest).

quests.summary: Recover Granny Bai's old hero badge and learn 12 Gate words; she teaches you Second Wind.

objectives.note: The camp's lanterns keep the fog out.

quests.summary: Carry lantern oil to Lantern Light Camp's three outposts to keep the Demon King's fog away.
